description: A copy of the bundled crates/fake_agent/scenarios/claude-files-one-turn.jsonl with the first read answered: the window's specs seed papers, so the window sends the first-read prompt in a thread of its own before the spec's prompt, and each thread's launch plays this file from the start. The first-read prompt gets a short answer and end_turn, touching no file; any other prompt plays the bundled turn: it creates notes/a.txt, edits brief.txt and deletes old.txt, each beside a tool_call naming its file. The test seeds brief.txt with 'Clause 4 draft' and old.txt first. Copied, not changed in place, because the host's tests play the bundled one as it is.

note: The handshake of common/claude-handshake.jsonl (the window plays this as claude-acp, which must answer session/new with its modes, in default), inline: a scenario read from a path includes from the common folder beside it, and this folder has none.

one_of.note: The first read (UD2): the window sends ui/app/src/room/first-read/prompt.ts's fixed prompt by itself in a thread of its own, for a matter with papers added on the first screen. A short answer, no file touched; first-read-scenarios.test.ts keeps this text equal to prompt.ts.

prompt.text: Read every paper in this matter's folder and give me a plain summary of the matter: who the parties are, what it is about, where it stands, and the dates that matter. Name each paper by its file name when you draw on it. Keep it short, in plain English, and say plainly where the papers leave something unclear.

content.text: A plain summary of the papers.
Created one note, edited the brief and deleted the old file.
